newsitem.title: UK: Lowe Group to form new media company.
newsitem.headline: Lowe Group to form new media company.

text.p: Advertising agency network, the Lowe Group, announced on Thursday that it will create a new media company across Europe in partnership with Initiative Media and US-based, Western International Media.
All three partners in the new company -- which will be called Western International Media, Europe -- are part of the Interpublic Group of companies.
As part of the deal Lowe will move its existing media business into Western International Media, Europe.

Initiative Media will use the new company as a second network which is expected to boost growth and allow it to handle conflicting business and the new company will also provide Western International Media's U.S. clients with a media operation in Europe.

Initiative Media's chairman, Marie-Jose Forissier, said: "We have been looking at the possibility of launching a new media company for some time, having been faced with the enviable problem of having to turn business away due to either full capacity or potential conflict. We always felt that the way forward was to utilise synergy with our IPG cousins."
The new company will be launched in January.
